entries.body: New native Capacity Fabric / glm-5.3 thread completed the launch and same-thread follow-up. It remembered the preceding acknowledgement. Host-assisted proof only; direct MCP, native lifecycle extension deployment and callbacks remain unproven.

The exact qualified SourceNotes helper appended this note through GitHub Contents expected-blob CAS and verified a fresh readback. No native session, provider configuration or credential was changed. Isolated client/notes/mission tests: 79 PASS. Native lifecycle extension remains source work.

Source-only MCP lifecycle extension delivered against an isolated public pingdotgg/t3code checkout at exact upstream commit 0770446869d247a8b28c27d7ed93f47f8ff0c1e4 (requested ref 0770446). New t3_thread_lifecycle tool in apps/server/src/mcp/toolkits/thread: guarded archive/unarchive, exact-target-confirmed delete (expectedTitle plus expectedUpdatedAt; native thread.delete tombstone; no files or worktrees removed), and idle model change restricted to the thread's current provider instance (Capacity Fabric here; provider switches refused). Built on McpToolAccess.writesThreads plus native ThreadManagement/Orchestrator commands; no new DB/queue/auth. Checks: focused tests 11/11 (stale snapshot, live/queued run, pending request, active child agent, provider-instance and replay-after-commit refusals); neighbor McpToolAccess suites 83/83; apps/server typecheck clean; vp run check:changed fully green after vp fmt and agentContextBudget.json 48116->49440 for the added tool. Deliverables in the requesting session workspace: candidate.patch (528 lines) and test-report.md beside the isolated checkout t3code/. LIMITS: expected-snapshot preconditions are advisory check-then-act read before dispatch, NOT CAS; the commit boundary is the orchestrator's serialized per-thread dispatch with native commandId receipt dedupe; native delete also cancels work and covers side chats; model change is same-instance only. NOT deployed, NOT pushed, NOT accepted upstream; model-behavior evals over the changed tool description and client surfaces not run. Original ordinal3 lifecycle task preserved; this note records the ordinal4 follow-up run.

Correction to native-t3-lifecycle-result: the parent source review (PR #2374 comment 6738835434) REJECTED that candidate. Its handler-level check-then-act preconditions were not the requested atomic expected-state guard, and same-instance model selection did not enforce capacity_fabric. Repaired in the same isolated checkout (upstream base unchanged at 0770446869d247a8b28c27d7ed93f47f8ff0c1e4): (1) preconditions moved into native commands at the serialized Orchestrator boundary. thread.delete gains optional expectedTitle/expectedUpdatedAt/onlyIfIdle and thread.model-selection.set gains optional expectedUpdatedAt/onlyIfIdle in packages/contracts; the orchestrator enforces them under the per-thread lock before planning, and violations fail as native rejected command receipts on the original commandId, so reconciliation replays the receipt instead of re-sending. (2) set_model now binds to the CALLING credential's own provider instance (capacity_fabric in this deployment; ProviderDriverKind is an open slug so no deployment string is hardcoded): thread credential required, selections on other instances, target threads on other instances, and provider switches refused. (3) archive/unarchive removed from t3_thread_lifecycle; parent reuses t3_thread_organize for those. New orchestrator-level race tests at the commit barrier (raced update vs parked delete under the thread lock, stale expectedTitle, live-run refusal, happy path): affected describe 10/10; handler tests 6/6; neighbor access suites 78/78; typecheck clean; vp run check:changed fully green; agentContextBudget.json 49613. Deliverables replaced in the requesting session workspace: candidate.patch (894 lines, 7 files: contracts, Orchestrator, tools, handlers, both test files, budget json) and a rewritten test-report.md with truthful acceptance status. REMAINING LIMITS: expectedUpdatedAt equality is millisecond granularity on updatedAt (the exact-title guard covers delete value confirmation; model-selection has no value guard); work a provider reports asynchronously after the under-lock idle check is still handled by native delete cancellation; a named-instance config surface for a different fixed instance would be a larger owner change. Final acceptance remains with the parent; nothing deployed or pushed. Prior note preserved verbatim; original ordinal3 task and ordinal4 run unchanged.
